instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: Lifecycle practices, integration and strategic challenges
topic_ar: ممارسات دورة الحياة والتكامل والتحديات الاستراتيجية

questions.question: Which practices belong to the pre-deployment stage?
questions.question_ar: أي ممارسات تنتمي لمرحلة ما قبل النشر؟
options: Runtime monitoring and policy enforcement.
Incident response and forensic capture.
Code reviews and automated static analysis.
Container scanning and secret validation.
options_en: Runtime monitoring and policy enforcement.
Incident response and forensic capture.
Code reviews and automated static analysis.
Container scanning and secret validation.
questions.explanation: Static analysis and review happen while the change is still in review, which is the cheapest moment to reject it.
questions.explanation_ar: التحليل الساكن والمراجعة يصيران والتغيير لا يزال قيد المراجعة، وهي أرخص لحظة لرفضه.

questions.question: Which practices belong to the deployment stage?
options: Code reviews and automated static analysis.
Runtime monitoring and adaptive policy.
Threat modelling and architecture review.
Container scanning and secret validation.
options_en: Code reviews and automated static analysis.
Runtime monitoring and adaptive policy.
Threat modelling and architecture review.
Container scanning and secret validation.
questions.explanation: At deployment the artefact itself is checked: what is inside the image and whether any secret slipped into it.
questions.explanation_ar: عند النشر يُفحص المخرَج نفسه: شنو داخل الصورة وهل تسرّب سر إليها.

questions.question: Which practices belong to the post-deployment stage?
questions.question_ar: أي ممارسات تنتمي لمرحلة ما بعد النشر؟
options: Runtime monitoring and adaptive policy enforcement.
Code reviews and automated static analysis.
Container scanning and secret validation.
Threat modelling and architecture review.
options_ar: الرصد وقت التشغيل وإنفاذ السياسة المتكيّفة.
options_en: Runtime monitoring and adaptive policy enforcement.
Code reviews and automated static analysis.
Container scanning and secret validation.
Threat modelling and architecture review.
questions.explanation: Once running, the only defence left is watching behaviour and adapting policy as the observed traffic changes.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد ما يشتغل، ما يبقى إلا مراقبة السلوك وتكييف السياسة مع الترافيك المرصود.

questions.question: What does lifecycle integration prevent?
options: Containers from being rebuilt each release.
Vulnerabilities accumulating across iterations.
Developers from committing any code at all.
Scanners from producing false positives.
options_ar: الحاويات من إعادة البناء كل إصدار.
المطوّرين من تثبيت أي كود أبداً.
options_en: Containers from being rebuilt each release.
Vulnerabilities accumulating across iterations.
Developers from committing any code at all.
Scanners from producing false positives.
questions.explanation: Each iteration adds code, so without integration the backlog of unfixed flaws grows faster than anyone can clear it.
questions.explanation_ar: كل دورة تضيف كوداً، فبلا تكامل يكبّر مخزون العيوب غير المصلَّحة أسرع من قدرة أي أحد على تصفيته.

questions.question: How is the vulnerability count carried across iterations?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُنقل عدد الثغرات بين الدورات؟
options: Previous count divided by elimination, plus introduction.
Previous count plus elimination, minus introduction.
Previous count times one minus elimination, plus introduction.
Previous count times elimination, minus introduction.
options_ar: العدد السابق × (واحد ناقص الإزالة)، زائد الإدخال.
options_en: Previous count divided by elimination, plus introduction.
Previous count plus elimination, minus introduction.
Previous count times one minus elimination, plus introduction.
Previous count times elimination, minus introduction.
questions.explanation: What survives is the untouched fraction of the old count, and new flaws arrive on top of it.
questions.explanation_ar: اللي يبقى هو الكسر غير المُزال من العدد القديم، والثغرات الجديدة توصل فوقه.

questions.question: What condition makes the practice sustainable?
options: Introduction rate exceeds elimination over the count.
Elimination equals introduction exactly, always.
The count remains constant between iterations.
Elimination rate exceeds introduction over the count.
options_ar: معدّل الإدخال يتجاوز الإزالة نسبةً للعدد.
معدّل الإزالة يتجاوز الإدخال نسبةً للعدد.
options_en: Introduction rate exceeds elimination over the count.
Elimination equals introduction exactly, always.
The count remains constant between iterations.
Elimination rate exceeds introduction over the count.
questions.explanation: Net reduction requires removing more than you add relative to what you already carry.
questions.explanation_ar: الانخفاض الصافي يتطلّب إزالة أكثر من الإضافة نسبةً لما تحمله أصلاً.

questions.question: Why does this recurrence resemble the strategic DevSecOps model?
questions.question_ar: ليش تشبه هذه التكرارية نموذج DevSecOps الاستراتيجي؟
options: Because both track removal against inflow.
Because both were published in the same standard.
Because both measure only the deployment stage.
Because both ignore the introduction of new flaws.
options_ar: لأن الاثنين يتتبّعان الإزالة مقابل التدفق الداخل.
لأن الاثنين يقيسان مرحلة النشر فقط.
لأن الاثنين يتجاهلان دخول ثغرات جديدة.
options_en: Because both track removal against inflow.
Because both were published in the same standard.
Because both measure only the deployment stage.
Because both ignore the introduction of new flaws.
questions.explanation: It is the same balance seen from a different angle: strategy sets the intent, the lifecycle is where the iteration actually happens.
questions.explanation_ar: هي نفس الموازنة من زاوية ثانية: الاستراتيجية تحدّد النيّة، ودورة الحياة هي وين تصير الدورة فعلاً.

questions.question: What do tools without disciplined practices produce?
questions.question_ar: شنو تنتجه الأدوات بلا ممارسات منظّمة؟
options: Faster delivery with fewer defects.
False assurance that the estate is protected.
Guaranteed compliance with every standard.
A measurable reduction in every risk.
options_en: Faster delivery with fewer defects.
False assurance that the estate is protected.
Guaranteed compliance with every standard.
A measurable reduction in every risk.
questions.explanation: The dashboards are green and the console shows detections, which is precisely why nobody notices that the process behind them is absent.
questions.explanation_ar: اللوحات خضراء والكونسول يعرض كشوفات، ولهذا بالضبط ما أحد يلاحظ إن العملية وراها غائبة.

questions.question: What happens to practices without supporting tools?
questions.question_ar: شنو يصير للممارسات بلا أدوات داعمة؟
options: They replace the need for automation.
They satisfy auditors without evidence.
They become unsustainable at scale.
They become more effective over time.
options_ar: تصير غير مستدامة على نطاق واسع.
options_en: They replace the need for automation.
They satisfy auditors without evidence.
They become unsustainable at scale.
They become more effective over time.
questions.explanation: A manual review process works for one team and collapses at fifty, which is why tooling is what makes a practice scale.
questions.explanation_ar: عملية مراجعة يدوية تشتغل لفريق واحد وتنهار عند خمسين، ولهذا الأدوات هي اللي تخلي الممارسة تتوسّع.

questions.question: How is combined effectiveness of tools and practices modelled?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُنمذَج الفاعلية المجمّعة للأدوات والممارسات؟
options: The sum of every tool and practice effectiveness.
The product of every tool and practice effectiveness.
The average of every tool and practice effectiveness.
One minus the product of all residual weaknesses.
options_ar: حاصل ضرب فاعلية كل أداة وممارسة.
واحد ناقص حاصل ضرب كل الضعف المتبقي.
options_en: The sum of every tool and practice effectiveness.
The product of every tool and practice effectiveness.
The average of every tool and practice effectiveness.
One minus the product of all residual weaknesses.
questions.explanation: Every tool and practice leaves its own remainder, and the product of those remainders is the chance that everything fails together.
questions.explanation_ar: كل أداة وممارسة تترك بقيتها، وحاصل ضرب تلك البقايا هو احتمال فشلها كلها معاً.

questions.question: A tool with effectiveness 0.9 and a practice with 0.8 are combined. What is total effectiveness?
questions.question_ar: أداة فاعليتها 0.9 وممارسة فاعليتها 0.8 تُجمعان. شنو الفاعلية الكلية؟
options: 0.98, since the residuals multiply to 0.02.
0.85, the average of the two values.
1.7, the sum of the two values.
0.72, the product of the two values.
options_en: 0.98, since the residuals multiply to 0.02.
0.85, the average of the two values.
1.7, the sum of the two values.
0.72, the product of the two values.
questions.explanation: The residuals are 0.1 and 0.2, whose product is 0.02, so effectiveness is one minus that.
questions.explanation_ar: البقايا هي 0.1 و 0.2، وحاصل ضربهما 0.02، فالفاعلية واحد ناقص ذلك.

questions.question: Why is combining a tool with a practice stronger than repeating one type?
questions.question_ar: ليش جمع أداة مع ممارسة أقوى من تكرار نوع واحد؟
options: Because repetition always doubles effectiveness.
Because different failure modes leave less residual.
Because tools cost less than practices overall.
Because practices are audited more often.
options_ar: لأن أنماط فشل مختلفة تترك بقية أقل.
لأن الأدوات أرخص من الممارسات عموماً.
options_en: Because repetition always doubles effectiveness.
Because different failure modes leave less residual.
Because tools cost less than practices overall.
Because practices are audited more often.
questions.explanation: A second copy of the same control fails the same way, whereas a different control type covers the mode the first one cannot.
questions.explanation_ar: نسخة ثانية من نفس الضابط تفشل بنفس الطريقة، أما نوع ضابط مختلف فيغطّي النمط اللي الأول ما يقدر يغطّيه.

questions.question: What risk does over-reliance on tools create?
questions.question_ar: أي خطر يخلقه الاعتماد المفرط على الأدوات؟
options: Automation slows down the whole deployment pipeline.
Tools duplicate the manual work done by analysts.
Excessive trust in automation misses sophisticated attacks.
Tool licences expire before the planned renewal date.
options_ar: الثقة الزائدة بالأتمتة تفوّت هجمات متطوّرة.
تراخيص الأدوات تنتهي قبل تاريخ التجديد.
options_en: Automation slows down the whole deployment pipeline.
Tools duplicate the manual work done by analysts.
Excessive trust in automation misses sophisticated attacks.
Tool licences expire before the planned renewal date.
questions.explanation: Automation is good at what it was told to look for, so an attacker who understands the model can stay outside its description.
questions.explanation_ar: الأتمتة شاطرة باللي انْتِگلها تدوّر عليه، فمهاجم يفهم النموذج يقدر يبقى خارج وصفه.

questions.question: What does the complexity of integration typically cause?
options: A reduction in the number of controls needed.
Faster detection across all the sources.
Lower cost of ownership for the estate.
Interoperability issues between the layers.
options_en: A reduction in the number of controls needed.
Faster detection across all the sources.
Lower cost of ownership for the estate.
Interoperability issues between the layers.
questions.explanation: Every additional layer is another product with its own data model, so the seams between them become the operational problem.
questions.explanation_ar: كل طبقة إضافية منتج ثاني بنموذج بياناته الخاص، فالمفاصل بينها تصير هي المشكلة التشغيلية.

questions.question: Which emerging threats does the chapter name as testing adaptability?
questions.question_ar: أي تهديدات ناشئة يذكرها الفصل كاختبار للتكيّف؟
options: Supply chain attacks and AI-driven malware.
Password reuse and weak recovery questions.
Expired certificates and misrouted DNS.
Disk failures and datacentre power loss.
options_ar: هجمات سلسلة التوريد والبرمجيات الخبيثة بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
إعادة استخدام كلمات المرور وأسئلة استعادة ضعيفة.
شهادات منتهية و DNS مسارها خاطئ.
أعطال أقراص وانقطاع كهرباء مركز البيانات.
options_en: Supply chain attacks and AI-driven malware.
Password reuse and weak recovery questions.
Expired certificates and misrouted DNS.
Disk failures and datacentre power loss.
questions.explanation: Both attack the assumptions the practices were built on: that dependencies are trustworthy and that attack tooling is unsophisticated.
questions.explanation_ar: الاثنان يهاجمان افتراضات بُنيت عليها الممارسات: إن التبعيات موثوقة وإن أدوات الهجوم بدائية.

questions.question: Which human factors remain strategic vulnerabilities?
questions.question_ar: أي عوامل بشرية تبقى ثغرات استراتيجية؟
options: Long meetings, late reviews and heavy workloads.
Misconfiguration, poor patching and coding resistance.
Hiring freezes, budget cuts and office relocation.
Slow laptops, small monitors and noisy offices.
options_ar: اجتماعات طويلة ومراجعات متأخرة وأحمال ثقيلة.
سوء الإعداد والترقيع الضعيف ومقاومة البرمجة الآمنة.
تجميد التوظيف وتخفيض الميزانية ونقل المكتب.
حاسبات بطيئة وشاشات صغيرة ومكاتب مزعجة.
options_en: Long meetings, late reviews and heavy workloads.
Misconfiguration, poor patching and coding resistance.
Hiring freezes, budget cuts and office relocation.
Slow laptops, small monitors and noisy offices.
questions.explanation: Tools and models cannot compensate for a team that misconfigures them or refuses to adopt the practice.
questions.explanation_ar: الأدوات والنماذج ما تعوّض فريقاً يعطّب إعداداتها أو يرفض تبنّي الممارسة.

questions.question: How do mathematical models mitigate these challenges?
questions.question_ar: كيف تخفّف النماذج الرياضية هذه التحديات؟
options: By automating every remediation action.
By proving that no attack can succeed.
By prioritising risks objectively.
By eliminating the need for human judgement.
options_en: By automating every remediation action.
By proving that no attack can succeed.
By prioritising risks objectively.
By eliminating the need for human judgement.
questions.explanation: They turn an emotional argument about which risk feels worse into a ranked list with numbers behind it.
questions.explanation_ar: تحوّل الجدل العاطفي حول أي خطر أسوأ إلى قائمة مرتّبة بأرقام وراها.

questions.question: What does the closing synthesis call the scientific foundation?
questions.question_ar: شنو يسمّيه التركيب الختامي الأساس العلمي؟
options: Procurement volume, vendor support and training.
Regulation, certification and audit frequency.
Headcount, budget and executive sponsorship.
Quantitative rigour, innovation and disciplined practice.
options_en: Procurement volume, vendor support and training.
Regulation, certification and audit frequency.
Headcount, budget and executive sponsorship.
Quantitative rigour, innovation and disciplined practice.
questions.explanation: The fusion of quantitative rigor, technological innovation and disciplined practices is what the document presents as the field's scientific basis.
questions.explanation_ar: التزاوج بين الصرامة الكمّية والابتكار التقني والممارسات المنظّمة هو اللي يقدّمه المستند كأساس علمي للمجال.
